import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'amount': [115.02, 44.37, 144.25, 536.22, 38.43],
    'is_fraud': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'transaction_type': ['refund', 'payment', 'transfer', 'payment', 'payment'],
    'hour_of_day': [22, 5, 21, 17, 5]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 10))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))

# 1. Transaction amount distribution
axes[0, 0].hist(df['amount'], bins=10, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7, color='skyblue')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Amount ($)')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Frequency')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Transaction Amount Distribution')
axes[0, 0].axvline(df['amount'].mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', label=f'Mean: ${df["amount"].mean():.2f}')
axes[0, 0].legend()

# 2. Transaction types distribution
type_counts = df['transaction_type'].value_counts()
axes[0, 1].bar(type_counts.index, type_counts.values, color=['lightcoral', 'lightgreen', 'lightblue'])
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Count')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Transaction Types Distribution')
for i, v in enumerate(type_counts.values):
    axes[0, 1].text(i, v + 0.1, str(v), ha='center')

# 3. Hour of day distribution
hour_counts = df['hour_of_day'].value_counts().sort_index()
axes[1, 0].bar(hour_counts.index, hour_counts.values, color='lightseagreen', alpha=0.7)
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Transaction Count')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Transactions by Hour of Day')
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(range(0, 24, 3))
for i, v in enumerate(hour_counts.values):
    axes[1, 0].text(hour_counts.index[i], v + 0.1, str(v), ha='center')

# 4. Amount by transaction type
type_amounts = df.groupby('transaction_type')['amount'].mean()
axes[1, 1].bar(type_amounts.index, type_amounts.values, color=['gold', 'orange', 'coral'])
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Average Amount ($)')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Average Transaction Amount by Type')
for i, v in enumerate(type_amounts.values):
    axes[1, 1].text(i, v + 5, f'${v:.2f}', ha='center')

plt.suptitle('Transaction Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
